div.div: Q. 1 هَمْلَجَ , (L, Msb,) inf. n. هَمْلَجَةٌ, (S, L, K, &c.,) He (a hackney, or pacing horse, بِرْذَوْن, S, L, &c., i. e. a رَهَوَان, TA,) went an easy and quick pace; (Msb;) he (a hackney, or pacing horse, or a beast,) went a good and quick pace; he went at a good and quick and graceful pace; (L;) he (a beast of carriage) went a good pace. (Abridgment of the 'Eyn.) See نَصَبَ السَّيْرَ.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
